tracks.title: Reise Durch Ein Brennendes Gehirn = Journey Through A Burning Brain
Asche Zu Asche = Ashes To Ashes

verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1970 (Germany).

notes.text:
Originally released in 1970 by Ohr (Germany).
Labels are green-with-red-stripe and red-with-green-stripe, cover is standard, not a gatefold.
Cover does not have any info on the spine and release number removed from front cover.
Inner bag white paper with care of your record information in English on top with 5 steps of care and French on the bottom with 6 steps of care.
Bold Outlined upside down V on the bottom of the inner bag after the French Care instructions.

The uncredited pressing company is derived from the logo of the group
/ Audio Graphic Industries, we can find on the run-out grooves. Disco France was the pressing plant of this group.
